summary: Verified the MongoDB _id serialization fix on admin menu item / category creation. Backend pytest (5/5) confirms POST /api/admin/menu/items and /api/admin/menu/categories return clean JSON without _id and data is persisted, updatable, and deletable. Unauthenticated create is blocked (401). Frontend E2E via Playwright: admin login OK; navigated to Menu Manager; opened Add Item dialog; filled Name/Price/Category/Description; clicked Save Item -> POST returned 200 with no _id, 'Item created' toast displayed, new item appeared in the list; Edit dialog opens successfully for existing items. Delete verified via API cleanup. MediaPicker (Choose from Library + Upload + Generate Image with AI) is integrated in the Add Item dialog.

issues: Radix a11y warning still present: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Non-blocking but should be fixed by adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to MenuManager Add/Edit dialog and MediaPicker dialog.

When opening the Add Item dialog freshly after page load, the Name and Price fields sometimes pre-populate with values from the first menu item (e.g. 'Pork Carnitas Tamale' / 4.99) instead of being empty. Form state is not reset when switching from edit -> add or on initial open. This is confusing UX but does not block creation (fields are overwritable). Reset form state to defaults when opening Add Item.

passed_tests: pytest backend/tests/test_menu_admin.py: 5/5 passed (login, list categories, create category no _id, create+update+delete item no _id + persistence, unauth blocked)
Admin login via UI (email/password) succeeds and sets cookies
Navigate to /admin/menu -> Menu Manager renders with Add Item / Add Category buttons
Add Item dialog opens with Name, Price, Category select, Description, MediaPicker (Choose from Library, Upload, Generate Image with AI), and Save Item
Fill form + select category + click Save Item -> POST /api/admin/menu/items 200
Response body contains item_id, name, price, category_id and does NOT contain _id
Success toast 'Item created' rendered after save
New item appears in the menu list without page reload
Edit button on an existing item opens the edit dialog
action_items: Optional: reset MenuManager item form state (name/price/description/category/image) whenever opening the Add Item dialog fresh - currently reuses last state which shows stale data on first open.
Optional a11y: add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to the Add/Edit Menu Item dialog and MediaPicker dialog to silence Radix warning.
Consider applying the same _id-strip pattern to any remaining admin POST endpoints (merch, blog, testimonials, faq, page_seo) via a small helper to avoid future regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1454-1461 create_menu_item and 1430-1435 create_category correctly pop '_id' after insert_one. Pattern is fine but repetitive across many admin POST endpoints; recommend a helper like `def clean(doc): doc.pop('_id', None); return doc` to reduce risk of missing an endpoint.
MenuItemCreate does not validate price >= 0 or name non-empty beyond pydantic defaults; consider Field(gt=0) on price and Field(min_length=1) on name for defensive input validation.
server.py has grown well past 700 lines - consider splitting admin/menu, admin/media, auth into separate routers for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_PW_Item via UI and TEST_CAT_pytest / TEST_ITEM_pytest via pytest; all cleaned up after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The _id serialization fix for admin menu item creation is fully verified end-to-end. Minor UX bug found: Add Item dialog opens with stale pre-populated values (looks like last edited item's data) on first open - not part of the reported bug fix but worth flagging. Radix DialogContent a11y warning still present.
